description: May 16 birthday meaning: Taurus decan 3, birthday number 7, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a May 16 birthday falls in Taurus, in the third decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Saturn as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 7. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Taurus is fixed and earth.

sections.heading: May 16 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Picture a stone wall in late spring, warm from the sun and covered in moss. The 16th of May has that quality: Taurus at twenty-five degrees, Saturn sub-ruling the decan, and 7 as the birthday number. It is often described as reserved, patient and inward, someone who gathers knowledge slowly and offers it only when sure it will be useful.

On May 16 the Sun usually sits at about 25° Taurus, in the third decan, where Saturn is the sub-ruler alongside Venus. The closing decan of Taurus answers to Saturn, ruler of Capricorn, and this lends the sign's earthiness a long-range, structural quality. Instead of only enjoying what is solid, mid-May natives are often drawn to building it: savings, institutions, skills that compound over decades. Astrologers tend to call them serious, reliable and quietly ambitious, with a dry humour that surfaces once trust is established. Saturn can also bring a heavier sense of duty and a habit of postponing pleasure until some imagined finish line. Remembering that Taurus is a Venus sign first can help, because rest and beauty belong inside the structure too.

sections.heading: May 16 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 16th reduces as 1 + 6 = 7, giving a birthday number of 7. In the compound, the 1 of the individual meets the 6 of home and responsibility, and the result is the 7's reflective, searching mind. Numerologists sometimes list 16 as a karmic debt number, linked with humility and rebuilding after the collapse of an outdated self-image. Those born on this day are often described as introspective, intuitive and capable of real personal reinvention. The day number is secondary, but in the 16 it frequently marks a rich inner life and a habit of questioning appearances.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one May 16 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 2 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example.

sections.heading: Born on May 16: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: May brings late spring in the northern hemisphere, a season of blossom and long evenings, and late autumn to the southern. Taurus holds the first three weeks, with Gemini arriving around May 20 or 21. In numerology May is month 5, the number of freedom, curiosity and change, which tends to give these birthdays a restless, experimental streak beneath the calm Taurean surface. May 16 is the 136th day of the year (137th in a leap year). By May 21, 5 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Gemini.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by May 16, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on May 16 include Megan Fox (1986), Andrzej Duda (1972) and Pierce Brosnan (1953).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is May 16?
faq.answer: May 16 is Taurus in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Taurus, which tradition links with Saturn.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on May 16?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On May 16 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 2 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 6 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 7 for everyone born on the 16th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on May 16?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a May 16 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on May 16?
faq.answer: May 16 is also the birthday of Megan Fox (1986), Andrzej Duda (1972) and Pierce Brosnan (1953). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
